subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Place the held hammer fully inside the box lengthwise, head left and handle right. Keep it above the raised flaps until centered.
Straighten the upright box by turning it counterclockwise viewed from above until its long edges run left to right. Keep the hammer inside and leave both grippers clear.
Pack the toy car in the free back half of the box lengthwise with its front facing left. Lift it above the rim first, keep the box aligned, and release it inside.
Withdraw the empty right gripper upward from the box. Use the left gripper to pack the shoe lengthwise toe-left in the free space beside the car, lifting above the flap before moving over the box.

The left gripper is holding the shoe above the table with its toe pointing right. Turn the shoe 180 degrees horizontally until the toe points left, then place it lengthwise in the back of the box beside the car.

Pick up the toe-left shoe resting on the table directly in front of the box. Keep its toe pointing left and its sole level. Lift it above the front rim and place it lengthwise into the empty rear pocket behind the car, then open and lift the gripper.
